editorial_note: All images visually reviewed by Claude for clarity, relevance, and grade-appropriateness. 5 of 9 original deterministic results were rejected and replaced via targeted editorial search.

images.author: Wikimedia Commons contributor
images.description: Barrel sponge on a coral reef — shows pores and natural underwater habitat
images.editorial_verdict: APPROVED — clear, colorful photo of sponge in habitat; pores visible

images.author: Luc Viatour
images.description: Moon jellyfish (Aurelia aurita) showing radial symmetry, bell shape, and trailing tentacles
images.editorial_verdict: APPROVED — stunning photo, radial symmetry clearly visible

images.author: Xavier japiot
images.description: Land planarian (Obama nungara) on moss — flat body shape clearly visible, bilateral symmetry evident
images.editorial_verdict: APPROVED — clear photo showing characteristic flat body shape

images.author: Wikimedia Commons contributor
images.description: Adult C. elegans nematode under microscope — translucent, thread-like shape, internal structures visible
images.editorial_verdict: APPROVED — textbook-quality microscope image of model nematode

images.author: Wikimedia Commons contributor
images.description: Earthworm on soil — segments clearly visible to the naked eye, recognizable by Grade 7 students

images.author: Chrumps
images.description: Rose chafer beetle (Cetonia aurata) — exoskeleton gleaming, jointed legs visible, on flowers
images.editorial_verdict: APPROVED — beautiful, clear beetle photo showing key arthropod features

images.author: Chris Prince Udochukwu Njoku
images.description: Snail shell showing spiral structure — demonstrates shell production by the mantle
images.editorial_verdict: APPROVED — clear shell spiral, good teaching aid for mollusk features

images.author: Richard Ling
images.description: Blue Linckia sea star (Linckia laevigata) on coral at the Great Barrier Reef — classic 5-armed pentaradial symmetry
images.editorial_verdict: APPROVED — stunning blue sea star, pentaradial symmetry unmistakable

images.author: DrChrissy
images.description: Montage of vertebrate classes: lamprey, shark, trout, bird, rat, crocodile, and red-eyed tree frog
images.editorial_verdict: APPROVED — excellent educational montage showing all 5 vertebrate classes
